name: 49418 · Grandville, MI
findings: ZIP 49418 (Grandville) has 142 nonprofit organizations. 70 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 56 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (42% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 49418 (Grandville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
